# Aydin Ayanzadeh

> Official personal site of Aydin Ayanzadeh, Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC). Research focuses on computer vision, medical image analysis, multimodal / vision-language models, and accessibility AI.
